title: First look and association checkpoint

blocks.what_we_do: Summarise the valid tests. Save the key association files so that you can restart from here.
blocks.why: A list of small p-values is not yet an interpretation. Before you plot, write down the model, the cohort, the number of tests and the fitting status. The next module explains [multiple testing](docs/glossary.md#multiple-testing), correlated peaks and confounding. Never call a simulated top result a clinical finding. Never assume that the nearest gene is the cause.
blocks.you_need: The association output from 6.3 and the table you reviewed at 6.4.
blocks.command:
```{r s6-6}
# 1. Read the results and summarise the study size and test values.
results <- guided_association(guided_path(cfg, "6.3", "association"))
summary <- data.frame(samples = 1811, retained_variants = 238513, finite_tests = sum(valid_p(results$P)),
  genome_wide = sum(results$P[valid_p(results$P)] < 5e-8),
  lambda_autosomes = lambda_gc(results$P[results$CHROM %in% as.character(1:22)]))
# 2. Save and print the summary table.
guided_write(summary, guided_path(cfg, "6.6", "summary.tsv"))
print(summary)
# Course bookkeeping: records the counts for the next step. Do not change.
files <- c(paste0(guided_path(cfg, "6.3", "association"), ".Disease.glm.logistic.hybrid"),
  guided_path(cfg, "6.2", "covariates.tsv"), guided_path(cfg, "6.4", "top20.tsv"), guided_path(cfg, "6.6", "summary.tsv"))
guided_artifact_checkpoint(cfg, "6.6", files)
check_step("6.6", data_dir = cfg$out, work_dir = cfg$out)
```

Plain PLINK 2 command (use `bin\plink2.exe` on Windows):

Not applicable. This step needs no PLINK operation. The R chunk is the complete command.

R reads or calculates the values it shows. It does not change the genotype files.
blocks.expected_result:
1,811 retained samples, 238,513 retained variants and 236,820 tests with finite p-values. Eight variants are genome-wide significant. The autosomal [lambda](docs/glossary.md#lambda-gc) is about 1.016. The key analysis files get a manifest: a list of files with their [SHA-256](docs/glossary.md#sha-256) checksums.


The tested PLINK version is defined in `config.R` and recorded in
`software_versions.txt`. Validation: executable chunks passed on Windows; main test counts and significance match the expected values.
blocks.troubleshooting: Stop at the first error. Check the input file named in the message and the previous step. Keep the command and the console log. Do not use files from a different version of the dataset. See [troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md).
blocks.quick_check:
Do eight significant variants always mean eight independent association signals?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>

No. Nearby variants can share one signal because of [linkage disequilibrium (LD)](docs/glossary.md#ld). Clumping at 7.5 groups the correlated associations.

</details>
